Procedure:
 Equipment Inspection 
 (I1- Y1)

Approved Date: 
 07 Sep 2006

Date to be Reviewed: 
 Sep 2011
Introduction

This document outlines 
 the equipment inspection checklist I1, to be carried out on an annually 
 bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block

Condensate water 
 circuit function is to transfer the main condensate water from main condenser to 
 feed water Tank (FWT) via Four LP Heaters.

Condensate water 
 circuit consists of two condensate pumps with 6KV motor drives, open loop 
 control & closed loop control for controlling condensate water circuit.

Open loop control 
 (sequence control), which have releases and protections for sequence control 
 group control (GC) & Sub-Group (SGC) and 6KV motor drive and its condensate 
 Pumps.

Closed loop 
 circuits function to control the main condenser level closed loop, feed water 
 tank level closed loop, and minimum flow closed loop to protect the condensate 
 pumps.

Main condenser 
 level closed loop to control the condenser level via the main condensate 
 control valve (from condenser to FWT).

Feed water tank 
 level closed loop to controls FWT level via make up control valves (from FWT 
 to make up tanks).

Minimum flow 
 closed loop to control the minimum flow via minimum flow control valve (from 
 discharge pumps to main condenser).

The closed loop 
 circuits components are Level/Flow transmitters, control system (DCS), and 
 motorized control valves (Siemens actuator).

The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Mahmoud Saad Eldin Bakry, tested by eng Waleed Wahba, revised by quality control eng. Abdel-Moniem 
 AlEmam EDEPC, accepted by I&C general manager eng. Ibrahim El-Sayed, and 
 approved by eng. Mokhtar Abd El-Latef Mady: Head Sector of Ataka PS.

This document 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil EDEPC 
 inspection & quality control 
 general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC 
 planning. & financial predecting and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.

Safety 
Precautions

items:
A work order must be issued; the maintenance staff should carry 
the suitable safety ID category.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, anti static 
 hand probe to avoid electrical shock etc
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
The unit must be out of service

sections.text:
Tools 
and Equipment

items: Digital multi-meter.
Screw driver kit, manual tools
Oil spry cleaner & Teflon roll.
Pneumatic Calibrator
External 24VDC power supply.
Current injector

sections.text:
Work to 
be Carried Out
For testing of condensate system perform the following:

First check releases and protections of the 
 condensate pumps

Second check closed loop circuits of 
 main condenser level, FWT level, and minimum flow
Preparation

items:
Obtain a copy of individual devices (level/flow transmitters, limit switches, 
 flow switches, temperature switch, RTD, diff. pressure switch, position transmitter, 
 motorize valve (Auma actuator), motorize control valves (Siemens 
 actuator), power adjuster) maintenance manuals.
Obtain a copy of SAMA diagram of condensate water control system.

sections.text:
First 
Releases and Protections of the Condensate Pumps

Releases and Protections of 
Sequence Control (GC & SGC) Condensate Pumps

items:
Check the Flow Transmitter of the main condensate water according to approved MPIS, and Checks low / high flow limit values setting. This Check needs the 
 unit out service.

Check the Limit Switches of close signal for HP Stop for valves and LP Bypass 
 stop valves according to approved MPIS. This check needs the unit out service.

Check the Level Transmitter of the main condenser according to approved MPIS, 
 and check high level limit value setting. This check needs the unit out 
 service.

Check Limit Switches of close signal for Min. flow control valve main 
 condensate water and level control valve of main condenser level.

sections.text:
Releases and Protections of 6KV 
Motor Drive for Condensate Pumps

items:
Check the motor cooling water flow switch according to approved MPIS, and 
 check signal F<Min. on the monitoring system

Check the Limit Switches of downstream and upstream valves according to 
 approved MPIS.

Check the Limit Switches of discharge first stage and suction second stage 
 valves according to approved MPIS.

Check the motorize (auma drive) valve stroke of Polishing unit bypass 
 according to approved MPIS.

Check the thrust bearing temperature switch according to approved MPIS, and 
 check signal T>Max. on the monitoring system.

Check RTD of slot winding temperature of 6KV motor according to approved MPIS 
 and check the limit values temperature setting.

Check the diff. Pressure switch of condensate filter pump according to 
 approved MPIS, and check signal DP>Max. on the monitoring system.
Check the Level Switches of condenser level according to approved MPIS.

sections.text:
Second Closed Loop Circuit of 
Condensate Water Circuit

Closed Loop Circuit of Main 
Condenser

items: Check the level transmitter according to approved MPIS.

Check the devices termination and cable termination of control valve (Siemens 
 actuator).
Check the power adjuster (24VDC/380VAC).

Check the open/close limit switches, open/close torque switches and check of 
 its mechanism.
Check the power supply position transmitter check of its mechanism.

Check the stroke of control valve and adjust position 
 transmitter according to stroke.

sections.text:
Closed Loop Circuit of FWT 
Level

items: Check the level transmitter according to approved MPIS.

Check the devices termination and cable termination of control valve (Siemens 
 actuator).
Check the power adjuster (24VDC/380VAC).

Check the open/close limit switches, open/close torque switches and check of 
 its mechanism.
Check the power supply position transmitter check of its mechanism.

Check the stroke of control valve and adjust position transmitter according 
 to stroke.

sections.text:
Closed Loop Circuit of Minimum 
Flow

items: Check the flow transmitter according to approved MPIS.

Check the devices termination and cable termination of control valve (Siemens 
 actuator).
Check the power adjuster (24VDC/380VAC).

Check the open/close limit switches, open/close torque switches and check of 
 its mechanism.
Check the power supply position transmitter check of its mechanism.

Check the stroke of control valve and adjust position transmitter according 
 to stroke.
